name: Context Mode
hook: Compresses 315 KB Claude Code sessions down to 5 KB by sandboxing tool output before it touches the context window — a verified 98% reduction. Persists session memory across resets and routes automatically across 17 platforms (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, VS Code Copilot, JetBrains, and more) via MCP + hooks. 25.5k stars; appeared in this week's Chase AI trending round-up.

name: Skills for Real Engineers (Matt Pocock)
hook: Matt Pocock (creator of ts-reset, Total TypeScript educator) published his personal .agents directory as a public repo — 38 composable skills built for production engineering work, not vibe coding. Key skills: /grill-with-docs builds a shared domain model, /wayfinder plans massive efforts, /tdd enforces red-green-refactor, /code-review runs a two-axis diff review against standards and spec. Went viral across multiple Hacker News threads; 277.8k stars.

name: Agent Reach
hook: One CLI that gives your AI agent read-and-search access to 13 internet platforms — Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, Instagram, LinkedIn, and more — with zero API fees. Multi-backend routing automatically fails over when an access method breaks. Gained 1.1k stars on October 6 alone; 92.5k total. MIT, compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex, and any MCP client.

name: Claude Context (Zilliz)
hook: Semantic code search MCP for Claude Code — hybrid BM25 + dense vector search across millions of lines, with incremental Merkle-tree indexing and AST-aware chunking across 37 languages. Creator-verified ~40% token reduction compared to loading directories into context directly. Supports OpenAI, VoyageAI, Ollama, and Gemini embedding providers; works with self-hosted Milvus or Zilliz Cloud. 12.6k stars.
install: claude mcp add claude-context -e OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-... -e MILVUS_ADDRESS=... -e MILVUS_TOKEN=... -- npx @zilliz/claude-context-mcp@latest

name: Claude Code v2.1.289–290: agent.spawn + Managed Agents
hook: v2.1.289 (Oct 3) and v2.1.290 (Oct 5–6) land two headline APIs: `agent.spawn` lets plugins launch named sub-agents with their own prompts, tools, disallowedTools, and effort levels; `serverToolUses` in the mod turn.step hook lists every tool call the advisor ran (with timings). The new `/claude-api managed-agents-onboard` command scaffolds the Managed Agents pattern as ant apply files in one command. `agentId` in tool.check events now distinguishes subagent checks from the main session.

name: OpenRig
hook: Open-source harness for running persistent networks of Claude Code and Codex agents together as one system. Define your team topology in YAML (RigSpec) — starter (2 agents), workshop (4), or factory (7) templates are included. `rig up` boots the team; `rig send` and `rig broadcast` let agents talk to each other; a terminal UI shows topology, state, and coordination live. MCP server support for agent-driven topology management. 5.4k stars, requires Node 22+, tmux, macOS/Linux.

name: Claude BugHunter
hook: Transforms Claude Code into a senior bug-hunting researcher — 83 skills, 15 slash commands (including `/hunt` for engagement scaffolding), and 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 vulnerability classes. Covers web app pentesting, cloud misconfigurations, OSINT/recon, and enterprise attack chains (M365/Entra, Okta, vCenter, SSL-VPN) with VRT-aware severity reporting and evidence hygiene. Burp Suite MCP integration included. Dual-licensed MIT + CC BY 4.0. 4.8k stars.

name: One Skill to Rule Them All
hook: A meta-skill that watches your Claude Code sessions — autonomous or human-led — captures patterns, corrections, and judgment calls, and turns them into skill improvement proposals for your review. The creator logged 1,600+ observations across 81 skills, most of which were improved or created by this meta-skill running in the background. Practical application of the Augmented Expertise methodology. 3k stars, CC BY 4.0.

name: Universal Modder
hook: Point Claude at any game you own and it mods it — 12 engine playbooks (Unity, Unreal, Godot, Source, Bethesda, Minecraft, RE Engine, and more), 10-step loop from recon through art generation (sprites, textures, 3D, SFX, music via fal MCP) to packaging. Still #1 global trending on GitHub October 6 with 4.0k stars, confirmed via daily trending tracker.
recurring_note: ↑ Day 4 — 4.0k stars; confirmed #1 global trending Oct 6

name: UI/UX Pro Max Skill
hook: v2.0's Design System Generator produces a complete tailored design system in seconds — 192 industry-specific reasoning rules, 79 UI styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 25 chart types, 16 tech stacks. 131.9k stars on GitHub, 347k+ installs in the Skillselion catalog.

name: ECC
hook: #1 on GitHub's claude-code topic with 272k stars. Wraps Claude Code with a complete SDLC: 293 reusable skills, 68 specialized agents, 94 workflow commands, AgentShield security scanning, and session-persistent memory. v2.2.3. The ethos: plan → test → implement → review → verify → remember → improve.

name: Ponytail
hook: Six-step YAGNI decision ladder before every code change: does this need to exist, is it in the codebase / stdlib / platform / deps, can it be one line? JetBrains benchmarked 15% output reduction; Chase AI's testing showed up to 50% code cuts and 53% Opus cost drop. 156k stars.

name: Caveman
hook: Forces responses into compressed caveman-speak while preserving code, commands, and exact error messages verbatim. JetBrains tested 86 Claude Code tasks: 8.5% fewer output tokens with no detectable quality change. Started as a Friday joke, hit #1 on HN with 904 points, now 109k stars.

name: Karpathy Guidelines Skill
hook: Forrest Chang turned Andrej Karpathy's frustrations with AI coding agents into four hard behavioral rules: think before coding, make surgical changes, surface assumptions and tradeoffs, define verifiable success criteria. Most-starred Claude Code behavioral skill on GitHub at 210k stars, 35.1k installs on the skills.sh registry. Works across all major agents.

name: Graphify
hook: Type `/graphify .` in Claude Code and it transforms your codebase — plus docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs — into a queryable knowledge graph. Local deterministic AST parsing via tree-sitter (37 languages, no LLM call) outputs graph.html (interactive visualization), GRAPH_REPORT.md, and graph.json. An MCP server mode enables repeated programmatic access. 123.4k stars.
install: uv tool install graphifyy && graphify install
